title: Laumufarþegi journeys
description: The host's and the players' experience of a game, as the page leads them through it: its screens in order, its how-to-play text and its prompts ("Sendu hlekkinn á hina, t.d. í Teams").

entities.name: Host a game for a group
entities.description: Someone starts a room, gets the group into it from a shared link, and runs the game to its winner.
entities.goal: Give a group of 3–10 people, each on their own device, a game of Laumufarþegi with as little setting up as possible.

stages.context: Opens the game's address; signed in to icelander.net, or told to sign in first.
stages.action: Types a name and starts a room.
stages.outcome: The lobby, with a five-letter code and a link.

stages.context: The group is somewhere else, for example in a Teams chat or meeting.
stages.touchpoint: The lobby's share link, then the group's own chat
stages.action: Copies the link and pastes it to the group.
stages.outcome: Players appear in the lobby's list as they join.

stages.context: The group is in; some may be children, or new to the game.
stages.action: Chooses the number of rounds, the time for clues and the vote, how hard the topics are and whether only child-friendly ones are used, and starts the game.
stages.outcome: The first round is dealt to everyone at once.

stages.context: The host plays each round like everyone else.
stages.action: Plays, and moves the group on from each reveal; removes anyone who should not be there.
stages.outcome: A running score after each round.

stages.context: The last round is over, or the group has had enough.
stages.action: Sees the winners; may start another game with the same players.
stages.outcome: The game is over; the room is deleted a day after its last use.

entities.name: Join a game from a link
entities.description: A player taps the link someone shared, plays the rounds on their own phone and sees who won.
entities.goal: Play along with the group without creating an account or installing anything.

stages.context: Someone has pasted the room's link, for example in Teams.
stages.touchpoint: The link, and the page's name entry
stages.action: Opens it, types a name and joins; no sign-in.
stages.outcome: The lobby with the others, the rules under Hvernig er spilað?, waiting for the host.

stages.action: Reads the topic's 16 words and their role: the secret word, or that they are the stowaway.
stages.outcome: Knows what to hide, or what to fake.

stages.context: Their turn comes, with a countdown.
stages.touchpoint: The clue box, then the vote
stages.action: Gives one clue, reads the others', and votes for whoever seems not to know the word.
stages.outcome: The vote catches the stowaway, who then guesses the word, or misses them.

stages.action: Sees the stowaway, the word, who voted for whom and the points.
stages.outcome: Their score so far; the next round when the host moves on.

stages.context: The phone locks, the page reloads or the connection drops.
stages.outcome: The page reconnects to the same seat with its stored token, score intact.

stages.action: Sees the ranking and the winners.
stages.outcome: Done, or another game with the same group.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases behind the journeys' stages.
